title: Stock Trading Simulator
subtitle: Real-time Trading Simulation with Learning Center
description: A comprehensive stock trading simulator built with Next.js, featuring a real-time matching engine, bot-driven market simulation, and an integrated learning center for trading education.
longDescription: A full-featured stock trading simulator that provides a realistic trading experience with real-time order matching, candlestick charts, and market analysis tools. The platform includes a sophisticated matching engine implementing price-time priority order matching with support for market orders, limit orders, and various order conditions (GTC, IOC, FOK). Three types of trading bots (MarketMakerBot, TrendBot, NoiseBot) simulate realistic market activity across different scenarios (Bull Market, Bear Market, Sideways, Volatile, Calm). The integrated Learning Center offers 19 courses across 4 categories (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Investment) with interactive quizzes and progress tracking. The Practice Center enables risk-free pattern recognition training and trading simulation with rewind/replay functionality. Real-time market analysis includes trend detection, order book scanning, momentum indicators, and automatic pattern detection with confidence scores.
features: Real-time order matching engine with price-time priority
Multiple order types: Market, Limit with GTC/IOC/FOK conditions
Interactive candlestick charts with multiple timeframes (15s, 1m, 5m, 30m)
Five market scenarios: Bull, Bear, Sideways, Volatile, Calm
Learning Center with 19 courses across 4 categories
Practice Center for pattern recognition and trading simulation
Real-time market analysis: trend detection, order book scanning, momentum indicators
Automatic chart pattern detection with confidence scores
Taiwan Stock Exchange tick rules for realistic price steps
Color theme toggle: Asian (red=up) vs Western (green=up)
Standard/Odd lot trading modes with configurable commission rates
